# Getting Support for Brave Music

Welcome! If you need assistance with Brave Music, desktop setup, audio playback, or development builds, here is how you can find help.

---

## 1. Join Our Community on Discord

The fastest way to ask questions, report minor issues, and collaborate with maintainers and other users is on the official COSL Discord server:

**[Join the COSL Discord Server](https://discord.gg/wD9d5Er7a)**

Key channels:
- `#general`: Say hello and discuss Brave Music features.
- `#labs-help`: Get assistance with local building, running, and debugging.
- `#project-ideas`: Discuss feature ideas and Android milestone proposals.
- `#code-reviews`: Share code and request feedback on pull requests.

---

## 2. GitHub Discussions & Issues

- **Installation & Setup Issues:** Check [docs/INSTALL.md](../docs/INSTALL.md) first for platform-specific instructions.
- **Reporting Bugs:** If you encountered playback failures, DRM errors, or crashes, please submit a [Bug Report](https://github.com/codemolabs/Brave-Music/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Feature Requests:** Share ideas and enhancements via [Feature Proposals](https://github.com/codemolabs/Brave-Music/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) or [Discussions](https://github.com/codemolabs/Brave-Music/discussions).
- **Search Before Filing:** Please search open and closed issues before opening a new thread to avoid duplicate conversations.

---

## 4. Formal & Security Inquiries

- **General Inquiries:** `cosl@codemoteams.org`
- **Security Vulnerabilities:** Please report security issues privately to **[security@codemoteams.org](mailto:security@codemoteams.org)** (or **[cosl@codemoteams.org](mailto:cosl@codemoteams.org)**) rather than opening a public issue. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
